DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メモでは八時、画面では九時となっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Alas-otso ang nasa tala, pero alas-nuwebe ang nasa screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: メモは腕時計を見て書きました。どちらが正しいかまだ分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 時刻の情報源と不明点を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tumingin ako sa relos ko nang isulat ko iyon. Hindi ko pa alam kung alin ang tama.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin sa Japanese ang pinagmulan ng oras at ang hindi pa malinaw.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面を後から変更しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Binago ba ninyo ang screen pagkatapos?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。そのまま保存しました。端末の時刻設定は確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保存画面の未改変を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi. Sinave ko lang iyon nang ganoon. Hindi ko pa nasuri ang setting ng oras ng device.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin sa Japanese na hindi binago ang naka-save na screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の記録は残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Pakisimpan ang orihinal na mga tala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 数字をそろえて書き換えず、使った時計をそれぞれ付記します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時計の出所を注記して原記録を守る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko papalitan ang mga numero para magtugma; ilalagay ko kung aling orasan ang ginamit sa bawat isa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang orihinal na tala at ilagay ang pinagmulan ng oras sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容を見た時刻と保存した時刻は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Pareho ba ang oras ng pagtingin sa nilalaman at pag-save?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少し違います。見た後、家に戻って保存しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 閲覧と保存の時点を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Medyo magkaiba. Pagkatingin ko, umuwi muna ako bago nag-save.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay sa Japanese ang oras ng pagtingin at pag-save.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順序も書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pakisulat din ang pagkakasunod-sunod na iyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見る、メモする、保存するという順番で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行動順で経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ipapaliwanag ko ang pagkakasunod: tumingin, nagtala, saka nag-save.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag sa Japanese ang pangyayari ayon sa sunod-sunod na ginawa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、時刻の不一致を残したまま経緯を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Kung gayon, pakikinggan ko ang nangyari habang pinananatili ang pagkakaiba ng mga oras.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 三個のお荷物をお送りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tatlong pakete ang ipapadala ninyo, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。控えの番号と相手を後で対応させたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 控えと届け先の対応を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Gusto kong maitugma mamaya ang numero ng resibo sa tatanggap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Hilingin sa Japanese na maitugma ang resibo sa padadalhan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お荷物ごとに控えが出ます。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、一個ずつ渡して、受け取った控えに自分の一覧の印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一件ずつ渡し控えを識別すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kung gayon, ibibigay ko nang isa-isa at lalagyan ang bawat resibo ng markang katumbas sa listahan ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang isa-isang magbigay at kilalanin ang bawat resibo sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 箱そのものの宛名も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Pakisuri rin ang pangalan at address sa mismong kahon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最初は姉、次は友人、最後は会社です。宛名の順も合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三件の順と宛名を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Una ang ate ko, susunod ang kaibigan, at huli ang kompanya. Tama rin ang ayos ng mga padadalhan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itugma sa Japanese ang pagkakasunod at padadalhan ng tatlong pakete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 控えはその順でお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ibabalik ko ang mga resibo sa ayos na iyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。番号を一覧へ写したら、控えにも同じ印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号一覧と控えの印をそろえる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Salamat. Pagkakopya ng mga numero sa listahan, lalagyan ko rin ng parehong marka ang mga resibo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itugma sa Japanese ang mga marka sa listahan ng numero at sa resibo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相手へ知らせる際は、一件ずつ見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kapag ipinaalam sa mga tatanggap, suriin muli nang isa-isa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 姉に友人の番号を送らないよう、宛先と番号をもう一度照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手へ送る番号を再照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Itutugma ko muli ang tatanggap at numero para hindi ko maipadala sa ate ko ang numero ng kaibigan ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Suriin muli sa Japanese ang numerong ipapadala sa bawat tatanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、最初の箱から受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige, tatanggapin ko ang unang kahon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 控えのどの部分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Aling bahagi ng resibo ang tinutukoy ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族に支払ったことを伝えたいんですが、この紙全体を写真にしていいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 控えの共有範囲を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gusto kong sabihin sa pamilya na nakabayad na ako, pero nag-aalangan akong kunan ng litrato ang buong papel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Kumonsulta sa Japanese tungkol sa bahaging maaaring ibahagi sa resibo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座の情報も含まれていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: May impormasyon din ito ng account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日付と金額だけ伝えれば、家族には用件が分かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族に必要な情報を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Maiintindihan ng pamilya ang pakay kung petsa at halaga lang ang sasabihin ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Limitahan sa Japanese ang impormasyon sa kailangan ng pamilya.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な内容に絞って共有できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Maaari ninyong ibahagi ang kinakailangang detalye lang.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 取引の表示も確認したいです。受付と完了は違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付と完了表示の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Gusto ko ring suriin ang status ng transaksiyon. Magkaiba ba ang tinanggap at nakumpleto?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong sa Japanese ang kaibahan ng tinanggap at nakumpleto sa display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示の意味は担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itatanong ko sa namamahala ang ibig sabihin ng status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認前には「完了した」と伝えず、今の表示をそのまま説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確認の完了を断定しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Bago makumpirma, hindi ko sasabihing nakumpleto na; ilalarawan ko mismo ang kasalukuyang nakalagay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang hindi tiyaking kumpleto hangga't hindi kumpirmado sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 控えはご自身で保管してください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。意味を確認してから、必要な内容だけ家族に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原控えを保管し必要情報だけ共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Oo. Pagkatiyak sa kahulugan, ang kailangan lang ang sasabihin ko sa pamilya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Itago ang orihinal na resibo at ibahagi lang ang kailangan sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、表示について確認しましょう。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日はこの時間に値引きされていたので、今日も待てば安くなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前日の値引きから当日予定を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Naka-discount ito kahapon sa ganitong oras. Mura rin ba ngayon kung maghihintay ako?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong sa Japanese ang plano ngayon batay sa discount kahapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 毎回同じ時刻とは限りません。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、昨日のことだけで今日の値段は決められませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 時刻が保証されないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kung gayon, hindi matitiyak ang presyo ngayon batay lang sa nangyari kahapon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Kumpirmahin sa Japanese na hindi garantisado ang oras.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の商品に付いた表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Pakitingnan ang kasalukuyang label sa produkto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この一個は今の表示で買います。待つことはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現時点の価格で購入を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Bibilhin ko itong isa sa presyong nakalagay ngayon. Hindi na ako maghihintay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Piliing bumili sa kasalukuyang presyo sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じ品が二つありますが、表示は別に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: May dalawang magkaparehong produkto, pero suriin ang label ng bawat isa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらには違うシールがあります。買う一個の表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同品でも個別表示を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: May ibang sticker itong isa. Susuriin ko ang label ng mismong bibilhin ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Suriin sa Japanese ang magkahiwalay na label kahit magkapareho ang produkto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計でもその商品をご提示ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Iharap din ang produktong iyon sa bayaran.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この一個だけかごに入れます。もう一つは棚へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入する一個を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ito lang ang ilalagay ko sa basket. Ibabalik ko sa estante ang isa pa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Limitahan sa Japanese ang bibilhin sa isang iyon lamang.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その商品の表示で会計へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige, tumuloy sa bayaran ayon sa label ng produktong iyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 集めた葉を全部使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Gagamitin ba ninyo ang lahat ng nakolektang dahon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 濡れた葉も混じっています。このまま貼るとどうなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 湿った素材の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: May halong basang dahon. Ano ang mangyayari kung ididikit nang ganito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong sa Japanese kung paano hawakan ang mamasa-masang materyal.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、乾いたものと分けてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ihiwalay muna natin sa mga tuyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 触って確かめて、乾いた三枚だけ選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乾いた葉だけを選別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hihipuin ko para suriin at tatlong tuyong dahon lang ang pipiliin ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Pumili lang ng tuyong dahon sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 緑を一枚、茶色を二枚にして、並び方を変えてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色と枚数の組合せを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Isang berde at dalawang kayumanggi ang gagamitin ko at susubukan kong baguhin ang ayos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Pumili ng kombinasyon ng kulay at dami sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ貼らずに置いてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ilatag muna nang hindi pa idinidikit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 丸く並べるより、斜めのほうが好きです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 貼る前に配置を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mas gusto ko ang pahilis kaysa pabilog na ayos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihambing ang ayos bago magdikit sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 残りの葉はどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ano ang gagawin ninyo sa natirang dahon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 工作用に残す分を相談して、不要な分は勝手に散らさず片付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 余材の処理を係と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Itatanong ko kung alin ang ititira para sa paggawa, at aayusin ang hindi kailangan nang hindi basta ikinakalat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Kumonsulta sa kawani tungkol sa natirang materyal sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その配置で貼り、残りは係と片付けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Idikit sa ayos na iyan at ayusin ang natira kasama ng kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の荷物を返す予定ですが、別の人が受け取るとメッセージが来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 第三者受取の曖昧な連絡を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Isasauli ko sana ang gamit ng kaibigan, pero may mensaheng ibang tao raw ang kukuha.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin sa Japanese ang malabong mensahe tungkol sa ibang taong kukuha.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受け取る方の名前は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Alam ba ninyo ang pangalan ng kukuha?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「いつもの人」とだけ書いてあります。これでは渡せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取人が特定できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: “Ang karaniwang tao” lang ang nakasulat. Hindi ko maibibigay sa ganoong impormasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag sa Japanese na hindi matukoy ang tatanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人に直接確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Direkta nating kumpirmahin sa kaibigan ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人へ電話します。知らない人に荷物の中身は言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人へ確認し中身を他者に話さない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tatawagan ko siya mismo. Hindi ko sasabihin sa hindi kilala kung ano ang laman.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Kumpirmahin sa may-ari at huwag sabihin sa iba ang laman sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待つ間、荷物はお手元に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Panatilihin sa tabi ninyo ang gamit habang naghihintay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話がつながりました。友人自身が戻って受け取るそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が戻るとの返答を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nakontak ko na siya. Siya mismo raw ang babalik para kunin ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Iulat sa Japanese ang sagot na babalik ang may-ari.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、その方をお待ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人に返します。知らない人への受け渡しはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人への返却だけを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sa kanya mismo ko ibabalik. Hindi ko ibibigay sa hindi kilala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Piliing isauli sa may-ari lamang sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内所の入口を空けて、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Huwag harangan ang pasukan ng information desk at dito maghintay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示の質問はこちらで受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Dito kami tumatanggap ng tanong tungkol sa eksibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子供が書いた質問ですが、私が言い換えたら難しくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大人の言い換えで難しくなったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tanong ito ng anak ko, pero naging mahirap nang baguhin ko ang pagkakasabi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag sa Japanese na pinahirap ng pagpalit ng matanda ang tanong.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元はどんな質問でしたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「なぜ昔の道は曲がっているの」です。今の紙には専門的な言葉を足してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元の質問と追加語を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: “Bakit paliko-liko ang mga lumang daan?” Nagdagdag ako ng teknikal na mga salita sa kasalukuyang papel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin sa Japanese ang orihinal na tanong at mga idinagdag na salita.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の疑問でも大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ayos lang ang orihinal na tanong.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、子供の言葉へ戻します。知りたいのは道の形の理由です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の疑問へ表現を戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kung gayon, ibabalik ko sa salita ng bata. Ang gusto niyang malaman ay dahilan ng hugis ng daan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ibalik sa Japanese ang pananalita sa sariling tanong ng bata.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明を受ける方法も選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maaari rin ninyong piliin ang paraan ng pagpapaliwanag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子供が図を見ると分かりやすいので、図がある資料を紹介してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 図のある説明資料を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mas naiintindihan ng anak ko kapag may diagram, kaya nais kong maipakilala ninyo ang babasahing may diagram.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Humiling ng materyal na may diagram sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料の有無を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itatanong ko sa namamahala kung mayroon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。子供には、まだ答えが出たのではなく資料を探していると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回答未確定の状態を子供へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat. Sasabihin ko sa bata na naghahanap pa ng materyal, hindi pa nakuha ang sagot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin sa bata sa Japanese na hindi pa tiyak ang sagot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 元の質問と資料のご希望を担当へ届けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipapasa ko sa namamahala ang orihinal na tanong at hiling ninyong materyal.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この一覧の薬を今も使っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ginagamit pa ba ninyo ang mga gamot sa listahang ito?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 全部ではありません。この一つは先週から使っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現用と中止薬の混在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi lahat. Hindi ko na ginagamit itong isa mula noong nakaraang linggo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin sa Japanese na may halong kasalukuyan at itinigil na gamot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中止した日を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Natatandaan ba ninyo ang petsa ng pagtigil?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 金曜日です。名前を消すだけでなく、日付を付けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中止日を注記する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Biyernes. Gusto kong idagdag ang petsa, hindi lang burahin ang pangalan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itala ang petsa ng pagtigil sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中止の経緯も担当へ説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ipaliwanag din sa namamahala kung bakit itinigil.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前の診察で指示を受けました。自分だけでやめたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中止の指示元を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Inutusan ako noong huling konsultasyon. Hindi ako basta tumigil sa sarili ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag sa Japanese kung kanino galing ang utos na itigil.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の薬も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Suriin din natin ang kasalukuyang mga gamot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今使う二つを別の欄へ写して、元の一覧は残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現用薬を区分し旧一覧を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kokopyahin ko ang dalawang ginagamit ngayon sa hiwalay na bahagi at ititira ang orihinal na listahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang kasalukuyang gamot at itago ang lumang listahan sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実物や薬の情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: May dala ba kayong gamot o impormasyon nito?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋を持っています。名称と量は袋を見て説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬袋で名称と量を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Dala ko ang mga supot ng gamot. Titingnan ko ang mga iyon para sabihin ang pangalan at dosis.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Gamitin ang supot ng gamot para sabihin ang pangalan at dosis sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、一覧と袋を一緒に担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipakita nang sabay ang listahan at mga supot sa namamahala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様の質問カードをお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tatanggapin ko ang question card ng anak ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ちょっと待ってください。「自転車で歩く」とあって、意味を聞いてから出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カードの曖昧な表現を指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sandali po. Nakalagay “maglakad gamit ang bisikleta”; gusto kong tanungin ang ibig sabihin bago isumite.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ituro sa Japanese ang malabong pahayag sa card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お子様は今こちらにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nandito ba ngayon ang anak ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。自転車を押して歩く場合のことだそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人へ確認した意図を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oo. Ang ibig daw sabihin ay maglakad habang inaakay ang bisikleta.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag sa Japanese ang layuning kinumpirma sa bata.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その言葉を付け加えると伝わりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Magiging malinaw kung idaragdag ang mga salitang iyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子供に「押して歩く」と書き足してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子供自身に表現を補ってもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ipapadagdag ko sa bata ang “maglakad habang inaakay”.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hayaang ang bata mismo ang magdagdag sa pahayag sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お名前を読み上げてよいかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Pakitanong din kung puwedeng basahin nang malakas ang pangalan niya.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 質問は読んで構いませんが、名前は読まないでほしいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 質問の公開と名前の公開を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Puwede raw basahin ang tanong, pero ayaw niyang basahin ang pangalan niya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay sa Japanese ang paglalantad ng tanong at ng pangalan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 匿名の質問として受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tatanggapin namin bilang tanong na walang pangalan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 直したカードを子供と見ました。こちらをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人と確認したカードを渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Tiningnan namin ng anak ko ang naitama nang card. Ito po ang tanggapin ninyo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang card na sinuri kasama ng bata sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 押して歩く場合の匿名の質問としてお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tatanggapin ko bilang tanong na walang pangalan tungkol sa paglalakad habang inaakay ang bisikleta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この封筒をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ipapadala ba ninyo ang sobreng ito?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。中に返信用封筒も入れます。切手の確認は二つ別ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往路と返信の料金確認を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Maglalagay din ako ng sobre para sa tugon. Hiwalay bang susuriin ang selyo ng dalawa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong sa Japanese ang pagsuri sa bayad sa pagpapadala at tugon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外に送る分と、返信で送る分は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay naming susuriin ang palabas na padala at ang ipapadalang tugon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 返信には一枚の書類を入れてもらう予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返信予定の中身を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Balak kong magpalagay sa tugon ng isang pahinang dokumento.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag sa Japanese ang inaasahang laman ng tugon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返信側の封筒と予定の中身も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Suriin din natin ang sobre para sa tugon at ang inaasahang laman.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ大きさの紙を持ってきました。見本として使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中身の見本を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: May dala akong kaparehong laki ng papel. Puwede bang gawing halimbawa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Magpakita ng halimbawang laman sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予定の重さを考える手がかりにはなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Makakatulong iyon sa pagtatantiya ng inaasahang bigat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返信に何が入るか相手にも確認してから、切手を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手へ返信内容を確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Tatanungin ko muna ang padadalhan kung ano ang ilalagay sa tugon bago pumili ng selyo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang kumpirmahin sa padadalhan ang laman ng tugon sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 外の封筒は、全部入れた後に量ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Titimbangin ang panlabas na sobre kapag nasa loob na ang lahat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。返信の準備が済んでから、外側を封します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返信準備後に外側を封する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Isasara ko ang panlabas na sobre matapos ihanda ang tugon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Isara ang panlabas na sobre matapos ihanda ang tugon sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、二つの発送条件を順に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige, isa-isa nating suriin ang kondisyon ng dalawang pagpapadala.
